text: Employees receive 24 days of paid leave per year.
Employees work from the office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Monday and Friday are optional work-from-home days.
Employees receive Rs 3000 per month for gym reimbursement.
Sick leave must be reported within 2 hours of shift start.
Annual bonus is paid in December based on performance.
Public holidays are observed as per Nepal calendar.
Maternity leave is 45 days with full salary.
Medical expenses up to Rs 50,000 are covered annually.
Casual leave requires 1 day advance notice.
Office timings are 9 AM to 6 PM with 1 hour lunch break.
Professional development courses are reimbursed up to Rs 20,000 per year.
Employees are entitled to 10 days of bereavement leave.
Mobile and internet allowance is Rs 1500 per month.
